verdict.rationale: The evidence shows public GOV.UK guidance pages explaining the visa routes, including the Innovator Founder route. It contains nothing showing the application forms themselves can be downloaded without an account. Instead it states "You must apply online," which points to an online-only transaction rather than downloadable forms. Readable guidance pages are adjacent to, not the same as, downloadable forms with their instructions.

support.subject: As a founder, the forms themselves and their instructions are downloadable from the service's site without an account
